links.outcome: Model performance in each of nine external samples predicting depression severity
links.effect: Overall r = 0.60 (SD = 0.089) across samples; per-sample r ranged from 0.48 (real-world general population sample) to 0.73 (real-world inpatients).
links.quote: The model reliably predicted depression severity across all samples (r = 0.60, SD = 0.089, p < 0.0001) and in each individual external sample, ranging in performance from r = 0.48 in a real-world general population sample to r = 0.73 in real-world inpatients.

screen.reason: Evaluates the external validity and generalizability of a predictive machine learning model across nine independent external datasets from research and real-world clinical contexts, but does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
